title: Aluminium hydroxide dissolves in acid and in alkali
caption: Al(OH)₃ is amphoteric. In acid it dissolves as Al³⁺(aq); in excess alkali as [Al(OH)₄]⁻(aq). In between, around pH 5 to 7, it is least soluble and precipitates. The curve is illustrative.
alt: log solubility of aluminium hydroxide against pH: a V-shaped curve, high at low pH, a minimum near pH 5.5, rising again at high pH.

checks.name: least soluble near pH 5.5, between the acid and alkali ranges (illustrative constants)
